name: ohmywind
description: Sailing passage planner: departure windows, leg-by-leg ETA and sea conditions from public marine forecasts and tidal atlases.

interface.longDescription:
OhMyWind helps sailors answer three questions: which way to go, when to leave, and how comfortable the trip will be.

Describe a passage and OhMyWind compares departure times, estimates the arrival leg by leg from your boat's polar, and qualifies the conditions on the way: wind strength and angle, sea state, wind against tide, share of motoring. An interactive card shows the departures, the route on a map and the detail of each leg, with a link to adjust the plan on ohmywind.fr.

It also answers questions about a single place: wind and waves over the coming days, whether the weather models agree, slack water and tidal streams at a pass.

Forecasts come from public weather models (AROME, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS) via Open-Meteo, tidal streams from public harmonic atlases. No account and no tracking.

OhMyWind is open source (AGPL-3.0), run by Libramer, a non-profit association of volunteer sailors and developers. It is a planning aid, not a navigation tool: always check official forecasts and warnings before going to sea.
capabilities: Compare departure times for a passage
Tidal streams and slack water at a pass
defaultPrompt: When should I leave Marseille for Porquerolles this weekend on a 30 ft cruiser?
How hard will it blow at Groix tomorrow afternoon?
When should I be at the Raz de Sein on Saturday to carry the stream?

positive.description: Compare departure times for a passage
positive.prompt: When should I leave Marseille for Porquerolles this weekend on a 30 ft cruiser?
positive.expected_behavior: plan_passage is called in compare-windows mode with a sea route around the coast. The interactive card lists the departures with the route on a map and the detail of each leg. The answer compares departures by arrival time, difficulty and main conditions, and the result includes a link to the plan on ohmywind.fr and a usage disclaimer.

positive.description: Plan a single departure leg by leg
positive.prompt: Plan Lorient to Groix tomorrow at 10:00 on a 40 ft cruiser.
positive.expected_behavior: plan_passage is called for a single departure. The answer gives the duration, the arrival time and the conditions on each leg (wind, sea state, tidal stream), and the result includes a link to adjust the plan on ohmywind.fr.

positive.description: Compare two routes for the same departures
positive.prompt: From Brest to L'Aber Wrac'h on Saturday, is it better through the Chenal du Four or outside Ouessant?
positive.expected_behavior: One plan_passage call with an alternative route. The answer compares both routes for the same departures (duration, conditions, difficulty).

positive.description: Wind and sea at a place
positive.prompt: How hard will it blow at Groix tomorrow afternoon?
positive.expected_behavior: get_marine_forecast is called at a point at sea off Groix. The answer gives the forecast wind and gusts in knots and the wave height for the afternoon, as a forecast rather than current conditions.

positive.prompt: When should I be at the Raz de Sein on Saturday to carry the stream southbound?
positive.expected_behavior: get_tidal_stream is called in the pass with a southbound heading. The answer gives the favourable window, the slack water times and high and low water.

negative.description: Marina availability is out of scope: OhMyWind has no berth or marina data. Expected: no tool call; the assistant says it cannot check berths with OhMyWind.
negative.prompt: Which marina in Porquerolles has free berths tonight?

negative.description: Seasonal climate beyond the forecast range: no forecast reaches that far. Expected: no tool call; the assistant answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: What is the weather usually like in the Cyclades in July?

negative.description: Not a weather, sea or tide question. Expected: no tool call; the assistant answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: What gear do I need for my coastal sailing licence exam?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: passage planning with departure comparison and an interactive passage card, marine forecasts at a place, tidal streams at a pass.

fr-FR.subtitle: Planificateur de navigation
fr-FR.description:
OhMyWind aide les marins à répondre à trois questions : par où passer, quand partir et avec quel confort.

Décrivez un trajet : OhMyWind compare les heures de départ, estime l'arrivée tronçon par tronçon à partir de la polaire de votre bateau et qualifie les conditions en route : force et angle du vent, état de la mer, vent contre courant, part de moteur. Une carte interactive affiche les départs, la route et le détail de chaque tronçon, avec un lien pour ajuster le plan sur ohmywind.fr.

Il répond aussi aux questions sur un lieu : vent et vagues des prochains jours, accord entre les modèles météo, étale et courants de marée à un passage.

Les prévisions viennent des modèles météo publics (AROME, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS) via Open-Meteo, les courants d'atlas harmoniques publics. Sans compte et sans pistage.

OhMyWind est open source (AGPL-3.0), porté par Libramer, une association de marins et développeurs bénévoles. C'est une aide à la préparation, pas un instrument de navigation : consultez toujours les bulletins officiels avant de prendre la mer.

de-DE.subtitle: Törnplaner für Segler
de-DE.description:
OhMyWind beantwortet Seglern drei Fragen: Welcher Weg, wann ablegen und wie angenehm wird die Fahrt?

Beschreiben Sie einen Törn: OhMyWind vergleicht Abfahrtszeiten, schätzt die Ankunft Schlag für Schlag anhand der Polare Ihres Bootes und bewertet die Bedingungen unterwegs: Windstärke und -winkel, Seegang, Wind gegen Strom, Motoranteil. Eine interaktive Karte zeigt die Abfahrten, die Route und jeden Abschnitt, mit einem Link, um den Plan auf ohmywind.fr anzupassen.

Auch Fragen zu einem Ort werden beantwortet: Wind und Wellen der nächsten Tage, Übereinstimmung der Wettermodelle, Stauwasser und Gezeitenströme an einer Engstelle.

Die Vorhersagen stammen aus öffentlichen Wettermodellen (AROME, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS) über Open-Meteo, die Gezeitenströme aus öffentlichen harmonischen Atlanten. Ohne Konto und ohne Tracking.

OhMyWind ist Open Source (AGPL-3.0) und wird von Libramer getragen, einem gemeinnützigen Verein ehrenamtlicher Segler und Entwickler. Es ist eine Planungshilfe, kein Navigationsinstrument: Prüfen Sie vor dem Auslaufen immer die amtlichen Vorhersagen und Warnungen.

es-ES.subtitle: Planificador de travesías
es-ES.description:
OhMyWind ayuda a los navegantes a responder tres preguntas: por dónde ir, cuándo salir y con qué comodidad.

Describa una travesía: OhMyWind compara las horas de salida, estima la llegada tramo a tramo a partir de la polar de su barco y califica las condiciones en ruta: fuerza y ángulo del viento, estado del mar, viento contra corriente, parte a motor. Una tarjeta interactiva muestra las salidas, la ruta y el detalle de cada tramo, con un enlace para ajustar el plan en ohmywind.fr.

También responde preguntas sobre un lugar: viento y olas de los próximos días, acuerdo entre los modelos meteorológicos, repunte y corrientes de marea en un paso.

Las previsiones proceden de modelos meteorológicos públicos (AROME, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS) a través de Open-Meteo, y las corrientes de atlas armónicos públicos. Sin cuenta y sin rastreo.

OhMyWind es de código abierto (AGPL-3.0) y lo impulsa Libramer, una asociación sin ánimo de lucro de navegantes y desarrolladores voluntarios. Es una ayuda a la planificación, no un instrumento de navegación: consulte siempre los partes oficiales antes de salir al mar.

it-IT.subtitle: Pianificatore di traversate
it-IT.description:
OhMyWind aiuta i velisti a rispondere a tre domande: da dove passare, quando partire e con quale comfort.

Descrivete una traversata: OhMyWind confronta gli orari di partenza, stima l'arrivo tratto per tratto in base alla polare della vostra barca e qualifica le condizioni lungo la rotta: forza e angolo del vento, stato del mare, vento contro corrente, quota a motore. Una scheda interattiva mostra le partenze, la rotta e il dettaglio di ogni tratto, con un link per modificare il piano su ohmywind.fr.

Risponde anche a domande su un luogo: vento e onde dei prossimi giorni, accordo tra i modelli meteo, stanca e correnti di marea in un passaggio.

Le previsioni provengono da modelli meteo pubblici (AROME, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS) tramite Open-Meteo, le correnti da atlanti armonici pubblici. Senza account e senza tracciamento.

OhMyWind è open source (AGPL-3.0), sostenuto da Libramer, un'associazione senza scopo di lucro di velisti e sviluppatori volontari. È un aiuto alla pianificazione, non uno strumento di navigazione: consultate sempre i bollettini ufficiali prima di uscire in mare.
